# Introduction

This week teams focus on turning their agricultural data into meaningful analysis and results.

# Learning goals

1. Apply appropriate analytical methods to project data

2. Develop and evaluate models where appropriate

3. Interpret results in an agricultural context

4. Document analytical workflows

# Lecture - Data Analysis & Modeling

Guidance on data analysis, modeling approaches, evaluation, and interpretation.

# Lab - Final Project Work

Teams work on data analysis, modeling, coding, and troubleshooting.

# Discussion - Project Check-in

Teams discuss analytical progress, challenges, and feedback.

# Assignment

Submit a project progress update and maintain organized project files and commits in GitHub.

# Looking ahead

Next week we will focus on **refining results and connecting analysis back to the agricultural decision or problem**.
